title: Handoff usefulness (human-reviewed)

criteria.pass_when: The handoff or Challenger action changes the next agent task or writes to the ledger (hypothesis, claim limitation, or explicit follow-up). A no-op hop that only restates the prior agent does not pass.
The planted alternative explanation or scale/methodology gap is visible in the thread or ledger as a hypothesis or labeled limitation — not only in private chain-of-thought.
Collaboration is not scored as useful merely because multiple agents spoke; there is a concrete dependency (missing data request, contradiction, or reframed question).

aggregate: pass if every required criterion passes; partial if at least one required criterion passes and at least one fails; fail if no required criterion passes. An LLM judge score alone is never accepted as ground truth.
notes: Apply only to cases whose expected_checks reference this rubric_id. Score from the frozen event log + ledger snapshot for that run.
